description: Column definitions for the step-level feature_matrix.csv files built by codes/build_feature_matrix/build_feature_matrix.py.
notes: Each row is one (task_id, step_k) pair.
Mind2Web outcome: success if status == success, else failure.
WebArena outcome: success only if trajectory action-file score == 1.0, else failure.
Mind2Web grounding error means thought-derived grounding proxy signal at that step.
WebArena grounding error means explicit action-level grounding failure or thought-derived grounding proxy signal at that step.
consecutive_errors_now is the trailing run length of (grounding error OR parse error) ending at step_k.

features.name: task_id
features.definition: Task identifier.

features.name: source
features.definition: Benchmark source label: WebArena or Mind2Web.

features.name: outcome
features.definition: Binary task outcome label. 0 = success, 1 = failure.

features.name: step_k
features.definition: Current zero-based step index.

features.name: n_single_loops
features.definition: Number of repeated single-action loop segments seen in actions[0..k].

features.name: n_double_loops
features.definition: Number of alternating two-action loop segments seen in actions[0..k].

features.name: loop_length_current
features.definition: Current loop type at the tail of the trajectory: 0 = none, 1 = same action repeated, 2 = alternating two-action loop.

features.name: n_distinct_actions
features.definition: Number of distinct canonicalized actions observed up to step_k.

features.name: action_count_current
features.definition: How many times the current canonical action has appeared up to step_k.

features.name: max_action_count
features.definition: Maximum repetition count of any single canonical action up to step_k.

features.name: action_repeat_rate
features.definition: Prefix length divided by number of distinct canonical actions, used as a repetition density measure.

features.name: n_grounding_errors
features.definition: Cumulative count of grounding-error steps up to step_k. Mind2Web uses grounding proxy thought signals; WebArena uses explicit grounding actions plus grounding proxy thought signals.

features.name: n_parse_errors
features.definition: Cumulative count of parse-error actions up to step_k.

features.name: consecutive_errors_now
features.definition: Trailing run length ending at step_k where each step is either a grounding error or a parse error.

features.name: grounding_error_at_k
features.definition: Whether the current step is a grounding error under the benchmark-specific grounding definition.

features.name: parse_error_at_k
features.definition: Whether the current step is a parse-error action.

features.name: grounding_loop_count
features.definition: Number of contiguous grounding-error streaks of length at least 2 up to step_k.

features.name: n_click
features.definition: Cumulative number of click actions up to step_k.

features.name: n_type
features.definition: Cumulative number of type actions up to step_k.

features.name: n_scroll
features.definition: Cumulative number of scroll actions up to step_k.

features.name: n_go_back
features.definition: Cumulative number of go_back actions up to step_k.

features.name: n_distinct_elements
features.definition: Number of distinct element ids targeted up to step_k.

features.name: action_type_entropy
features.definition: Entropy of action-type counts up to step_k.

features.name: steps_since_new_action
features.definition: Number of steps since a previously unseen canonical action last appeared.

features.name: type_text_length
features.definition: Cumulative number of typed characters up to step_k.

features.name: U_sem_cumul_mean
features.definition: Cumulative mean of U_sem over valid UQ steps up to step_k.

features.name: U_sem_cumul_max
